description: This file defines the HttpResponseToJavaSerializer class, which serializes HttpResponse objects into Java code representations, including headers, cookies, body, delay, and connection options.

classes.name: HttpResponseToJavaSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts HttpResponse objects into Java code strings for mocking purposes.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an HttpResponse object into a formatted Java code string with indentation.

methods.name: outputCookies
methods.description: Appends cookie serialization code to the output buffer if cookies are present.

methods.name: outputHeaders
methods.description: Appends header serialization code to the output buffer if headers are present.

methods.name: appendObject
methods.description: Serializes a list of objects using a provided serializer and appends to the output.

methods.name: appendNewLineAndIndent
methods.description: Appends a newline and indentation spaces to the output buffer.
